methodology.unit: task; average three repetitions within each language before resampling
methodology.primary: mean paired hidden full-task success-within-verified-budget difference
methodology.time: median of per-task mean restricted times; unsuccessful cells censored at 1200 seconds
methodology.repairs: mean augmented burden: accepted cell uses actual repairs; unsuccessful cell uses 4
methodology.reasoning_tokens: subset of output_tokens, never added to sampled output total
methodology.model_provenance: requested gpt-6.1-sol/high; JSONL does not return a backend-resolved model snapshot

deviations_or_limits: Time estimator difference: the operationalized sensitivity gate uses the median of per-task mean restricted times, with unsuccessful attempts set to 1200 seconds; this is not the literal preregistered accepted-only solution-time median

Repair estimator difference: the operationalized sensitivity gate uses mean augmented repair burden, with unsuccessful attempts set to 4; this is not the literal preregistered actual public-repair count

continuation_assessment.interpretation: Failure-penalized sensitivity gate not established; favorable point estimates alone do not establish advantage. The literal preregistered accepted-only time / actual-repair threshold is not established by this gate
